name: crip-costpulse
description: CRIP domain agent: grounded Azure spend, daily trends with anomaly detection, and month-end forecast from Azure Cost Management.
summary: Spend by any dimension, daily trends with spike detection, and Azure's month-end forecast.

delegation_tool.name: ask_costpulse
delegation_tool.description: Ask the CostPulse agent about Azure SPEND: how much was spent, what costs the most (by resource group, resource type, service or tag), how daily cost is trending, which days had unusual spikes and which services drove them, what the month-end total is forecast to be, and which subscriptions the user can see. Answers come from live Azure Cost Management data with the exact query and data timestamp.

examples: What is my month-to-date spend by resource group?
Were there any cost spikes in the last 30 days? What caused them?
What will my bill be at the end of this month?

tools.name: costpulse_query_costs
tools.description: Actual cost at a scope for a time window, grouped by one dimension. Runs with the signed-in user's own Azure permissions. Returns a JSON contract with status (ok/partial/no_data/error), answer, data, query_used, data_timestamp, sources and caveats.

scope.description: Azure scope: a subscription id (GUID), /subscriptions/<id>, /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<name>, or /providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/<id>. If the user has not identified one, call costpulse_list_subscriptions first.

group_by.description: Dimension to group cost by. Defaults to resource_group.

tag_key.description: Tag name to group by. Required when group_by is 'tag'.

top_n.description: How many of the largest groups to itemise. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: costpulse_cost_trend
tools.description: Daily cost series for the last N days, with the trend direction, anomalous spike days (robust median/MAD rule) and the services that drove each spike. Use for 'why did my costs go up', 'any spikes', 'is spend rising'.

scope.description: Subscription id, /subscriptions/<id>, /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<name>, or a management group scope.

days.description: How many days back to analyse. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: costpulse_forecast_month_end
tools.description: Actual cost so far this month plus Azure Cost Management's own forecast for the remaining days, giving a projected month-end total. Use for 'what will my bill be', 'are we on track'.

scope.description: Subscription id, /subscriptions/<id>, /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<name>, or a management group scope.

tools.name: costpulse_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the Azure subscriptions the signed-in user can see (with their own permissions). Use this when the user has not said which subscription they mean.
